definitions.provider_snapshot: Full provider snapshot time is unknown; stats_calculated_at dates only recalculated metrics.
definitions.minute_stats: Persisted provider metrics; window ends at stats_calculated_at and lasts stats_window_sec seconds. Not recomputed by this report.
definitions.in_progress: After the minute-stat update, in_progress_count/amount count all applications in that minute, not concurrent unfinished operations.
definitions.skip_reasons: Distinct operation/provider/reason combinations across routing_attempts and provider_skip_reasons; the latter may contain imported reference expectations.

routing_coverage.definition: Population: distinct operation IDs in operations_queue UNION routing_decisions. History-only operations are excluded; awaiting_decision is not the pending_operations metric.

reference_comparison.definition: Compare provider IDs only for valid references with a recorded decision; missing decisions are not mismatches. Reference agreement does not validate all runtime constraints.

uncompared.reference_reason: vipay max=100000, payflow max=50000 — только quickpay принимает 150000
gazprombank не в banks у vipay и payflow — только quickpay
amount=800 < limit_amount_min=1000 у vipay и quickpay — только payflow (min=500)
raiffeisen не в banks у vipay и payflow — только quickpay

definitions.attempt_count: Logged evaluation steps, including skipped providers; not HTTP requests. Orphans and synthesized reference skips are excluded.
definitions.first_choice: Exactly one selected provider matching the final choice in a contiguous ordered log, without explicit fallback/failure evidence. Static eligibility skips do not count as dispatch failures.
definitions.fallback: spacepayments final choice, explicit fallback reason, multiple selected providers, or a recorded failure before the final choice. Classification is based on retained logs, whose completeness is unverified.
definitions.success: simulated_result = approved; no per-attempt payment outcome or verified live/simulation provenance is stored.
definitions.first_attempt_success_pct: Approved first-choice operations / all classified operations.
definitions.cohort_approval_pct: Approved operations / operations within the corresponding first-choice or fallback cohort.

segments.definition: Same deduplicated population as total_operations; decisions override history. Approval denominator is all operations in the segment. Provider shares are within each segment. Amounts use database units; invalid amounts/latencies are excluded from numeric sums/statistics and invalid amounts are counted.

period_comparison.definition: Latest observed UTC day before generated_at versus the immediately preceding day. Completed days use [00:00, next 00:00); today uses [00:00, generated_at) and the same elapsed interval yesterday. No substitution of an older nonadjacent day.
caveats: Source coverage/completeness is not recorded; no observations do not prove zero activity.
Uses currently stored statuses and decision overrides, not reconstructed past outcomes.

skip_reason_sources.definition: Counts use distinct operation/provider/reason tuples. Source-separated counts overlap and must not be added. Only routing_attempts is a recorded routing trace; provider_skip_reasons has no reliable fact/reference provenance flag.

freshness.definition: Age is measured from stored event/reference times, not ingestion time. Negative age identifies future timestamps. Timezone-free dates are interpreted as UTC. No freshness SLA or ingestion watermark is available.

providers.reason: Full snapshot/target/limit timestamp is not stored.

distribution_status_latency_segments.source: operations_history + routing_decisions; decision wins on duplicate operation_id
distribution_status_latency_segments.outcome_provenance: History status plus simulated_result from decisions; live versus sample origin is not stored.

pending_queue.source: operations_queue excluding IDs present in history or decisions

routing_coverage_reference_comparison_ca.source: queue, raw decisions, raw attempts and references; all retained rows

skip_reasons.source: See skip_reason_sources; legacy skip_reasons remains their deduplicated union.

provider_state_utilization_recommendatio.source: Current stored provider fields; snapshot freshness is unknown. Minute metrics have separate windows above.

period_comparison.source: Same deduplicated operations; UTC windows are explicit in period_comparison.
